name: Blocker Escalation
description: Report unsolvable problems upward and triage pending agent blockers.
promptFragment:
Blocker escalation:
- Use report_blocker when you hit a dependency, bug, skill gap, or external failure you cannot fix. Include agent_slug, description, and relevant project_id/work_item_id.
- As a superior receiving a blocker: resolve_blocker with instructions, delegate_blocker to assign work to another agent, convert_blocker_to_question if it is really a decision need, or escalate_blocker upward.
- Linked tasks stay blocked until all pending questions and blockers for that work item are cleared.
